==English==
[[File:Caterpillar track shingle.JPG|thumb|'''[[Wikipedia:Continuous track|Caterpillar track]]''' on a bulldozer.]]

===Pronunciation===
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-caterpillar track.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# A [[Wikipedia:Generic trademark|generic trademark]] name for a [[continuous track]] in the form of a steel or rubber belt fitted around the [[wheel]]s of [[crawler]]s, [[bulldozer]]s, [[excavator]]s, [[loader]]s, [[backhoe]]s, [[tank]]s and similar off-road [[vehicle]]s in such a manner as to spread the load on the ground surface and thereby improve traction and reduce sinking into soft surfaces. 
#: {{syn|en|continuous track|track|crawler}}

====Usage notes====
The name came originally from the Caterpillar Tractor Company, but is now common as a [[Wikipedia:Generic trademark|generic trademark]] in uncapitalised form.
